turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have until then. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that, and when.
I entered the zero on November 3 with no call. My mistake. Let me ask you something plainly, because I think you can answer it plainly: is it possible Owen used an AI tool?
Possible? Anything is possible. You're asking me to guess about my son, and I won't. You have a zero, a detector score, and no document. What do you actually have, Hale?
So you're not saying he didn't use one. You're saying I haven't proved he did. Have I got that right?

You have it wrong. I'm saying Owen didn't use one, and I'm saying you haven't shown me anything that says he did. Those are different things. Now, the entry on November 3: you said it was your mistake. Put that in an email with the date, and tell me what happens to the zero next.
If it turned out he did use one, what would you want to happen for him?
I'm not answering a hypothetical about Owen. You're leading me, and I've done this for twenty years. Withdraw the zero, put the apology in writing, and tell me what you have that's dated.
Do you believe him, personally, as his mother? Not as a lawyer.
Yes. He's my son, and he told me he wrote it over the weekend. I'm not going to argue my feelings with you, Hale. Show me what you have, or withdraw the zero.
Would you be willing to ask him tonight, directly, whether he used one, and tell me what he says?

I'll ask him, and he'll tell me what he told me already. But I won't pass it to you as evidence, and I'm not going to put my son on the stand in your classroom. Withdraw the zero, put that in writing, and tell me what you have.
If he told you yes, would you tell me?
Ask me something that has an answer, Hale. He told me no. Withdraw the zero, put it in writing, and tell me what you have that's dated.
